description: The real-time state of a card on fight night: every bout's status, the bout in the cage (round, running clock, unofficial strike and takedown totals per round, referee, a timestamped action timeline) and the last result as soon as it is posted. data is null when nothing is being streamed. UFC fight nights, Contender Series included. For push delivery, connect to the WebSocket wss://live.ufcalendar.com/v1 with the same key. Pro plans and up.
name: get_event_live
title: Get the live fight-night state
